messages.content: 請問過去10天內，蘋果公司在那斯達克上市的股價是多少？另外，請問過去15天內微軟公司在紐約證券交易所上市的股價又是多少？謝謝。

function.name: get_stock_price
function.description: Retrieve the stock price for a specific company and time frame. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

company.description: The ticker symbol of the company.

days.description: Number of past days for which the stock price is required.

exchange.description: The stock exchange where the company is listed, default is NYSE

We need to retrieve stock prices. The user wants Apple on Nasdaq for past 10 days, and Microsoft on NYSE for past 15 days. But Apple is actually listed on NASDAQ, ticker AAPL. Microsoft is listed on NASDAQ as well, ticker MSFT. But user says Microsoft on NYSE. That is incorrect; but we can still provide data. We need to call get_stock_price function twice: one for Apple with days=10, exchange="NASDAQ". Another for Microsoft with days=15, exchange="NYSE". But the function signature: company: string, days: number, exchange?: string. So we call get_stock_price with company="AAPL", days=10, exchange="NASDAQ". And second call with company="MSFT", days=15, exchange="NYSE". Then we need to format the response. The function returns any. We need to output the results. The user wants the stock price. Likely we need to provide a list of daily closing prices. We'll call the function twice.
